title: Universal No Prompt Cooldown
features: Find it frustrating when something takes too long like for example your trying to open a door and to open the door you have to hold e for a few seconds well this script solves anything prompt related it basically removes the hold duration for prompts and makes them instant
script:
local function removeHold(prompt)
    if prompt:IsA("ProximityPrompt") then
        prompt.HoldDuration = 0
    end
end

for _, descendant in ipairs(game:GetDescendants()) do
    removeHold(descendant)
end

game.DescendantAdded:Connect(removeHold)
